patterns.note: The site uses a full-bleed hero image that transitions into a standard content width for subsequent sections, often employing a two-column layout for feature blocks (image on one side, text on the other).

A clean, bright white background dominates most content sections, contrasted with a dark charcoal grey for the footer and a vibrant, warm red for primary call-to-action buttons and announcement banners.

The hero image exhibits a subtle parallax effect, scrolling slower than the foreground content until it moves out of view. The main navigation bar and a top announcement banner stick to the top of the viewport after initial scroll.
Product listings are presented in a responsive grid of five columns, featuring product images, names, prices, and star ratings, maintaining a consistent card-like structure.
Headings use a clean, modern sans-serif font with varying weights to establish hierarchy, while body text maintains high readability with a slightly lighter weight sans-serif.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a classic parallax depth effect. The header elements, including an announcement bar and main navigation, are fixed to the top of the viewport after the initial page load, ensuring persistent access.

Sections are revealed as the user scrolls, with new content appearing from the bottom of the viewport. A modal popup, likely triggered by scroll depth or time, is used to capture email subscriptions with a discount offer.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are clean sans-serifs, moderately larger (~2-3x body) and bolder than the readable body text, establishing a clear hierarchy without being overly dramatic.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and input fields, while product cards and images maintain sharp, crisp corners.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical spacing between major content sections and a more dense, uniform grid for product displays.

standout: The site's standout feature is its exceptional product photography, showcasing translucent bottles with vibrant, colorful liquids. This artistic visual approach is integrated seamlessly into a clean, minimal design, allowing the products themselves to be the primary visual draw and brand identifier.
